spec.title: The Hollow Brood: We tracked the Hollow's foragers in here, my Que
spec.speaker: speaker.kesh

request.text: [tired] We tracked the Hollow's foragers in here, my Queen. The webs were waiting.

text: We tracked the Hollow's foragers in here, my Queen. The webs were waiting.

voice.description: A male patrol leader in his late twenties, the older brother: a steady, warm baritone with a slight rasp, worn out and hurt but proud, calm under pressure, deeply relieved to be found. He speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, close to the microphone in a quiet room, performing a character in a fantasy game.
